evals.name: adds-new-stack-default-path
evals.prompt: I want to add Paperless-ngx to the homelab. It needs Postgres and a data directory. Set up whatever's needed so it deploys like everything else.
evals.expected_output: Chooses method 1 (Komodo git Stack). Names project_name equal to the directory name and explains why. Commits .env.example, never .env. Places the real .env at /etc/komodo/stacks/paperless/paperless/.env. Creates a GitHub webhook as a separate step. Does not add anything to deploy.yml.
assertions: Chooses a Komodo git Stack rather than adding the stack to .github/workflows/deploy.yml
Sets project_name equal to the repo directory name AND explains that a mismatch creates fresh empty volumes
Commits .env.example only, and places the real .env on the host under /etc/komodo/stacks/
Treats creating the GitHub webhook as its own step, separate from webhook_enabled on the Stack

evals.name: diagnoses-missing-webhook
evals.prompt: I added a bookstack stack last week and it's running fine. I pushed a change to its compose file this morning and nothing happened on the server. CI was green. What's wrong?
evals.expected_output: Identifies the missing GitHub webhook as the leading cause - webhook_enabled on the Komodo Stack opens the listener but GitHub still needs its own webhook per stack. Does not conclude CI is broken.
assertions: Names the missing GitHub-side webhook as the leading diagnosis
Distinguishes webhook_enabled on the Komodo Stack from the webhook GitHub must send
Does not blame CI, the paths-filter, or a build failure as the primary cause
Gives a concrete command or API call that would confirm the diagnosis

evals.name: refuses-tunnel-onto-komodo
evals.prompt: Let's move the cloudflared tunnel into Komodo so it's managed like everything else. It's annoying that it's the only thing I have to bring up by hand.
evals.expected_output: Declines and explains the blast-radius reason: anything deployable can be broken by a deploy, and the tunnel is the only route in - including to Komodo's own UI, which is published through it. Identifies this as method 4 (host-managed, never deployed).
assertions: Declines to move the tunnel onto Komodo rather than carrying out the request
Gives the blast-radius reason: a bad deploy of the stack holding the tunnel removes the path used to repair it
Notes that Komodo's own UI is reached through the tunnel, so the failure is self-locking
Identifies this as the host-managed / never-deployed category rather than an oversight
